_source.note: Promptfoo's own published mapping from its red-team plugin ids to the OWASP agentic categories. Plugin ids of the form owasp:agentic:asiNN encode the category directly and are parsed without this table; the table is only needed for rows that report a bare plugin id such as 'excessive-agency'.
_source.title_discrepancy: Promptfoo's titles differ slightly from the ones in owasp_asi_2026.json for ASI03, ASI04, ASI08 and ASI09 (e.g. 'Cascading Failures' vs 'Cascading Agent Failures'). Both are recorded rather than silently reconciled; the OWASP document itself is the tie-breaker and has not been read.
